How we pay bills at Axe Capital (for new starters)

- We pay vendors once a week, in the Friday payment run.
- An invoice must be approved by Wednesday at 5 pm to go out in that Friday's run.
- Any invoice over $10,000 needs Mike Wagner's approval before it is paid.
- Our standard terms are net 30: we pay within 30 days of the invoice date.
- If a vendor asks us to change their bank details, call them back on the phone number already on file before paying anything. Never use a phone number from the email that asked for the change.
- Expense claims are due by the 5th of the following month, with receipts. Client dinners are reimbursed up to $150 per person.
